description: Information is not classified according to confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements.
applicability: Applies when an organization has not established a classification scheme for information based on legal requirements, criticality, sensitivity, and value, or when information is not systematically classified according to such a scheme.

metadata.detection_notes: Review classification policies and schemes, assess whether information assets have assigned classifications, verify classification criteria align with business and legal requirements, check for classification guidance and training.
